(Translated by Google) Kiki offers the best guide service. It went all beyond expectation. He's friendly, helpful, and a super good filmer.

Yusuf is super fast, the ride was smooth. Recommended for anyone considering a trip to Ijen and Bromo.

Kiki and Yusuf provided a fantastic experience; their three-day itinerary and resourcefulness far exceeded expectations.
